clips.caption:
Happy, sad, happy, sad, happy, sad — most people just accept that as what life is.

It isn't the only option. The driver that actually sustains happiness instead of cycling through it is connecting to source, a level of consciousness and awareness most people never tap into on purpose. Once that connection is live, the ups and downs stop running your state for you. You can feel steady on a random Tuesday with nothing good having happened at all.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to connect.
